text: Then where to seek a proper protector for you against the confusion and chances of such a scene?” “None is necessary,” returned Cora; “who will dare to injure or insult the daughter of such a father, at a time like this?” “I would not leave you alone,” continued the youth, looking about him in a hurried manner, “for the command of the best regiment in the pay of the king. Remember, our Alice is not gifted with all your firmness, and God only knows the terror she might endure.” “You may be right,” Cora replied, smiling again, but far more sadly than before.
